verdict.rationale: Canny's own integrations link feedback to Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp and Asana issues and sync their statuses, so a PM can see the status of linked work inside Canny. Nothing in the evidence shows a real-time per-task view, blocker reasons, or last-update timestamps. Missing for 10: real-time in-progress task monitoring view, what each task is blocked on, last-update tracking, and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can watch the real-time status of each in-progress task, including what it's blocked on and its last update
